audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict their own reasons. whys[0] says neither champion can commit (that is Skill, labelled Akshan); whys[1] describes his camouflage-plus-swing window against a stunless Irelia (Akshan, labelled Skill); whys[2] literally says 'it's a coinflip' (Skill, labelled Irelia); whys[4] says Vanguard's Edge traps him with no disengage (Irelia, labelled Akshan). The packet levelChart matches the prose on all four.
audit.why: Akshan gets Going Rogue and Heroic Swing before Irelia gets Flawless Duet, so level 2 is his; level 3 is the coinflip; level 6 is Irelia's on the blade wall.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 set to Skill / Akshan / Skill / Irelia in both layers, ratings re-scored.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic 'Vanguard's Edge walls off his disengage' boilerplate with 'his' and no mechanic, and did not mention Comeuppance at all despite level 6 being his ult timing too.
audit.why: Comeuppance (100/85/70s) stores bullets and fires them for missing-health damage; Defiant Dance's damage reduction is the answer to the barrage, and its physical nature matches Akshan's all-physical kit.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to name the blade wall cutting his retreat and holding Defiant Dance for the barrage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dirty Fighting (P) shields him on every third hit from attacks and abilities — nothing anywhere in either layer mentioned the shield, so the all-in maths in tradeGood/dosFull is wrong by one shield.
audit.why: Riot's text: every three hits deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion. That absorbs exactly the burst window Irelia's E-into-Q chain is built around.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1] rewritten to force the proc out on minions before committing.

audit.why: The existing claim that Vanguard's Edge walls off the terrain Heroic Swing grapples toward is not verifiable from Riot's data (the mirror audit flagged the same doubt). I left it exactly as written rather than strengthening or removing it.

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither can commit — he has Avengerang poke, you have Bladesurge. Stack Ionian Fervor off the wave and concede nothing.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: Going Rogue's camouflage and Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1) both land before your Flawless Duet — he pokes in and swings out free.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Flawless Duet finally answers Heroic Swing, but Avengerang still kites you — a coinflip on who lands their key ability first.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge cuts the retreat his Heroic Swing needs, so your dive strands him. Hold Defiant Dance for the Comeuppance barrage.
Pop his shield before you commit

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Akshan when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit — force that proc on minions, then E-stun and Q-reset before it comes back.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Stackless Ionian Fervor means no on-hit — he swings out and re-pokes you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: He swings off terrain — deny the angle by fighting in open lane.

notes: Unverifiable and left untouched: whether Vanguard's Edge counts as grappleable terrain for Heroic Swing. Both the content layer and spikes[1] currently assert the wall blocks his grapple; Riot's data cannot confirm it and the mirror audit raised the same doubt. If it is wrong, spikes[1].text and whys[4] are both built on it.
